title: LiDAR-based 3D Change Detection at City Scale
abstract: arXiv:2510.21112v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-definition 3D city maps enable city planning and change detection, which is essential for municipal compliance, map maintenance, and asset monitoring, including both built structures and urban greenery. Conventional Digital Surface Model (DSM) and image differencing are sensitive to vertical bias and viewpoint mismatch, while original point cloud or voxel models require large memory, assume perfect alignment, and degrade thin structures. We propose an uncertainty-aware, object-centric method for city-scale LiDAR-based change detection. Our method aligns data from different time periods using multi-resolution Normal Distributions Transform (NDT) and a point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) method, normalizes elevation, and computes a per-point level of detection from registration covariance and surface roughness to calibrate change decisions. translated_title: 基于LiDAR的城市尺度三维变化检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2510.21112v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：高清晰度三维城市地图支持城市规划和变化检测，这对于市政合规、地图维护和资产监控（包括建成结构和城市绿地）至关重要。传统的数字表面模型（DSM）和影像差分法对垂直偏差和视角不匹配敏感，而原始点云或体素模型需要大量内存、假设完美对齐，并会退化薄结构。我们提出了一种基于不确定性感知、以对象为中心的方法，用于城市尺度LiDAR变化检测。我们的方法使用多分辨率正态分布变换（NDT）和点到平面迭代最近点（ICP）方法对齐不同时间段的数据，归一化高程，并根据配准协方差和表面粗糙度计算每个点的检测水平，以校准变化决策。基于几何的关联通过语义和实例分割进行细化。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于不确定性感知和对象中心的方法，结合多分辨率NDT和点对平面ICP对齐、高程归一化及协方差校准，实现了城市尺度LiDAR三维变化检测，并利用语义和实例分割提升精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware, object-centric method for city-scale LiDAR-based 3D change detection, using multi-resolution NDT and point-to-plane ICP alignment, elevation normalization, and covariance-based calibration, enhanced by semantic and instance segmentation.
